metadata.title: [Perf][SM70][DeepSeek-V4.1] Build the routed-expert plan inside the q8 quantize launch (VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE, default off)
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

Independent of our other PRs; applies to `main` alone. Our fast routed-expert kernel PR builds on it.

## Purpose

At decode, the DeepSeek-V4.1 TP4 row-split routed experts (GGUF IQ experts through `gguf_v41_moe.py`) run `q8_aligned` (Q8 quantization of the activations) and then `gate_up7`, which first builds the per-expert plan (`moe_plan`) and then does its dots.

With **`VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE=1`** (default off), a new v41k kernel `q8_plan` quantizes the activations and writes the plan in one launch, and `gate_up7p` reads the plan instead of building it. This removes one launch and the plan prologue from every MoE layer.

- `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41k/v41k.cu`: `q8_plan`, `gate_up7p`.
- `gguf_v41_moe.py`: `_q8_and_plan` selects them when the switch is on, raises if the loaded `v41k.so` lacks them, and logs the first use once (module logger added; `main`'s file had none).
- `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/plan_fuse_check.py`: one-GPU bit check of today's pair against the fused pair: q8 bytes and scales, the whole 512-entry plan buffer (prefilled with garbage), the gate/up output, and a finite check, M = 1..6, 300 trials per M. This PR adds `--no-time` (bit checks only).
- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_plan_fuse.py`: CPU dispatch tests.

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check
python -m tools.config_inventory --check
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_metadata.py
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_registration.py
python -m tools.generate_architecture_reference --check
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_plan_fuse.py
python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41k/build.py                 # sm_70
python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/plan_fuse_check.py --lib v41k.so --no-time   # one V100
```

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fused plan | GGUF IQ routed experts | SM70, decode M <= 6, `VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE=1` | `q8_plan` + `gate_up7p`; missing ops raise | GPU bit check (one V100); CPU dispatch tests; measured on 8x V100 | other gtypes than checked here |
| Switch off | all | default | `q8_aligned` + `gate_up7`, unchanged | CPU dispatch tests | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: opt-in; `VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE` defaults off.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: `VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE=1` and a `v41k.so` built from this tree.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: the #1277 packed-KV default.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port; this branch is the change alone, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: `v41k.so` (this tree's `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41k`).
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: below; the route logs `VLLM_V41_PLAN_FUSE=1: expert plan built in q8_plan, gate_up7p` once.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: unchanged.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no variable renamed or removed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: one experimental variable with metadata; references pass.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: +1 registered, 0 unregistered reads.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-03,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, DeepSeek-V4.1 PP2 x TP4, DSpark 5, one request, paired ABBA arms, switch on vs off: **-0.36 ms per round at T=0, -0.27 ms at T=1.** Output texts identical.

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** on this branch rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`:

- sm_70 build of `v41k.so` from this tree, then `plan_fuse_check.py --no-time` on one V100-SXM2-32GB for gtypes 29 / 16 / 17 (IQ1_M, IQ2_XXS, IQ2_XS): **0 mismatches** in the plan buffer, q8 bytes and scales, and gate/up output, M = 1..6, 300 trials per M; every output finite.

- pytest `test_deepseek_v41_plan_fuse.py`, CPU only: 408 passed.
- `generate_env_reference --check`, `config_inventory --check`, `check_env_metadata.py`, `check_env_registration.py`, `generate_architecture_reference --check`: all pass.
- ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check`: pass.

Not re-run: timing (the GPU check ran with `--no-time`) and serving.

---
